owasp_categories: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures
A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: Forged webhook / callback from third party — Paymob Payment Gateway → Booking API
findings.description: Booking API accepts callbacks from Paymob Payment Gateway (Payment data). Without signature verification an attacker can forge 'payment successful' or status events.
owasp_top10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

findings.title: Internet-exposed admin panel without MFA — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Clinic Admin Dashboard is reachable from the internet and protected only by session. Staff accounts are the highest-value phishing target.

findings.title: IDOR / Broken object-level authorization — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API exposes records by ID (Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama, Payment data, Credentials / tokens). If ownership is not checked server-side, changing an ID returns another customer's data.

findings.title: Payment amount / order tampering — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API handles payments. If totals, discounts or amounts are accepted from the client, attackers can pay less than the real price.

findings.title: Weak session / token lifecycle — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API uses jwt tokens; without expiry, rotation and server-side revocation a stolen token stays valid indefinitely.

findings.title: Account takeover via single-factor authentication — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API authenticates users with jwt only. Phished, reused or leaked passwords give an attacker full access to Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama, Payment data, Credentials / tokens.

findings.title: Account takeover via single-factor authentication — Patient Mobile App
findings.description: Patient Mobile App authenticates users with password only. Phished, reused or leaked passwords give an attacker full access to Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), Credentials / tokens.

findings.title: Account takeover via single-factor authentication — Patient Booking Website
findings.description: Patient Booking Website authenticates users with jwt only. Phished, reused or leaked passwords give an attacker full access to Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), Credentials / tokens.

findings.title: Credential stuffing / brute force on login and OTP — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: No rate limiting is documented for Clinic Admin Dashboard. Automated credential-stuffing or OTP guessing can take over accounts.

findings.title: Credential stuffing / brute force on login and OTP — Booking API
findings.description: No rate limiting is documented for Booking API. Automated credential-stuffing or OTP guessing can take over accounts.

findings.title: Credential stuffing / brute force on login and OTP — Patient Booking Website
findings.description: No rate limiting is documented for Patient Booking Website. Automated credential-stuffing or OTP guessing can take over accounts.

findings.title: Stored / reflected XSS in browser UI — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Clinic Admin Dashboard renders user-supplied content. Without output encoding and CSP, script injection can steal sessions of staff or customers.
asvs: V5.3 Output Encoding and Injection Prevention

findings.title: Stored / reflected XSS in browser UI — Patient Booking Website
findings.description: Patient Booking Website renders user-supplied content. Without output encoding and CSP, script injection can steal sessions of staff or customers.
asvs: V5.3 Output Encoding and Injection Prevention

findings.title: Unauthenticated call across a trust boundary — Booking API → Session & Queue Cache
findings.description: Flow Booking API -> Session & Queue Cache crosses from 'dmz' to 'data' without authentication.

findings.title: SQL / NoSQL injection into backend data store — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Clinic Admin Dashboard builds queries against a data store and no input-validation / parameterization control is documented.
asvs: V5.3 Output Encoding and Injection Prevention

findings.title: Malicious file upload — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API accepts file uploads (e.g. documents, images, lab results). Unrestricted uploads enable web shells, malware hosting and stored XSS.

findings.title: Sensitive data sent in cleartext — Clinic Admin Dashboard → Patients & Appointments DB
findings.description: Flow Clinic Admin Dashboard -> Patients & Appointments DB uses TCP and carries Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama. Anyone on the path (Wi-Fi, ISP, internal network) can read or modify it.

findings.title: Sensitive data sent in cleartext — Booking API → Patients & Appointments DB
findings.description: Flow Booking API -> Patients & Appointments DB uses TCP and carries Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama. Anyone on the path (Wi-Fi, ISP, internal network) can read or modify it.

findings.title: Sensitive data sent in cleartext — Booking API → Session & Queue Cache
findings.description: Flow Booking API -> Session & Queue Cache uses TCP and carries Credentials / tokens. Anyone on the path (Wi-Fi, ISP, internal network) can read or modify it.

findings.title: Publicly readable storage bucket / predictable file URLs — Lab Results Storage
findings.description: Lab Results Storage holds files (Health data (PHI)). Misconfigured public access or guessable URLs are a top cause of SME data leaks.

findings.title: Unauthenticated cache exposes session / personal data — Session & Queue Cache
findings.description: Session & Queue Cache caches Credentials / tokens with auth 'none'. Unauthenticated Redis/Memcached is routinely found and dumped.

findings.title: Secrets in source code / server env files
findings.description: No secrets manager is documented. Payment-gateway keys, DB passwords and JWT signing keys tend to live in git or .env files.

findings.title: Broken function-level authorization (user reaches admin functions) — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API serves both end users and staff/admin functions. Missing server-side role checks let normal users call privileged endpoints.

findings.title: Mass assignment of privileged fields — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API binds request bodies to models. Without explicit DTOs a user can set fields such as role, is_admin, salary or price.
owasp_top10: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

findings.title: Secrets extractable from the client app — Patient Mobile App
findings.description: Patient Mobile App ships to user devices. API keys or partner credentials embedded in the bundle can be extracted and abused to impersonate the app.

findings.title: Vulnerable third-party libraries (no SCA)
findings.description: No dependency scanning is documented for the custom code (npm/composer/pip/pub). Known-vulnerable packages are a common entry point.

findings.title: No centralized security monitoring / alerting
findings.description: There is no documented security monitoring. Breaches at SMEs are typically discovered months later, by customers or regulators.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: Resource exhaustion on public API — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API is internet-facing without documented rate limits; scraping or floods can take the service down or inflate cloud bills.

findings.title: SMS/WhatsApp OTP pumping & messaging abuse — WhatsApp Business API (via Twilio)
findings.description: WhatsApp Business API (via Twilio) sends OTP / notifications. Bots can trigger thousands of messages (toll fraud) or spam patients/customers.

findings.title: Sensitive logs leak data — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API logs requests, but log redaction is not documented. Logs become a second, poorly-protected copy of Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama, Payment data, Credentials / tokens.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: Sensitive data stored unencrypted at rest — Patients & Appointments DB
findings.description: Patients & Appointments DB stores Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama without documented encryption at rest. A stolen backup, snapshot or disk exposes everything.

findings.title: Sensitive data stored unencrypted at rest — Lab Results Storage
findings.description: Lab Results Storage stores Health data (PHI) without documented encryption at rest. A stolen backup, snapshot or disk exposes everything.

findings.title: Over-privileged database account — Patients & Appointments DB
findings.description: Patients & Appointments DB: applications typically connect with owner/DBA rights; any injection becomes full database compromise.

findings.title: No audit trail for access to sensitive records — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Clinic Admin Dashboard processes Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama but no audit logging is documented. Insider misuse or a breach cannot be investigated or proven.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: No audit trail for access to sensitive records — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API processes Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), National ID / Iqama, Payment data, Credentials / tokens but no audit logging is documented. Insider misuse or a breach cannot be investigated or proven.
owasp_top10: A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

findings.title: Personal data shared with third party beyond need — Paymob Payment Gateway
findings.description: Paymob Payment Gateway receives Payment data, Personal data (PII). Over-sharing with processors without a DPA creates privacy and regulatory exposure (Egypt PDPL / KSA PDPL).

findings.title: Personal data shared with third party beyond need — WhatsApp Business API (via Twilio)
findings.description: WhatsApp Business API (via Twilio) receives Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI). Over-sharing with processors without a DPA creates privacy and regulatory exposure (Egypt PDPL / KSA PDPL).

findings.title: No WAF / DDoS protection at the edge — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API is exposed directly. Volumetric and application-layer DDoS (common around Ramadan / White Friday sales) has no absorption layer.

findings.title: No WAF / DDoS protection at the edge — Patient Booking Website
findings.description: Patient Booking Website is exposed directly. Volumetric and application-layer DDoS (common around Ramadan / White Friday sales) has no absorption layer.

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — Clinic Admin Dashboard
findings.description: Clinic Admin Dashboard: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — Booking API
findings.description: Booking API: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Verbose errors / debug mode in production — Patient Booking Website
findings.description: Patient Booking Website: stack traces and framework debug pages disclose internals and sometimes secrets.

findings.title: Sensitive data stored insecurely on device — Patient Mobile App
findings.description: Patient Mobile App may cache tokens or Personal data (PII), Health data (PHI), Credentials / tokens on the device in plain storage, exposed on lost/rooted phones.

remediation_plan.title: Enforce MFA for privileged and staff accounts
remediation_plan.detail: TOTP / passkeys for admin, doctor, finance and HR roles; SMS OTP only as fallback.

remediation_plan.title: Verify payment & partner webhook signatures
remediation_plan.detail: Validate HMAC (e.g. Paymob HMAC, Fawry signature) and re-query transaction status server-to-server before fulfilling.

remediation_plan.title: Restrict admin panel to VPN / IP allow-list
remediation_plan.detail: Serve the back office on a separate host, behind VPN or Cloudflare Access / Zero-Trust.

remediation_plan.title: Object-level authorization on every record access (anti-IDOR/BOLA)
remediation_plan.detail: Central policy check that the caller owns / may access the record; use non-guessable IDs; add automated authz tests.

remediation_plan.title: Recompute amounts and prices server-side
remediation_plan.detail: Never trust totals, discounts or amounts from the client; sign the order before redirecting to the gateway.

remediation_plan.title: Rate limiting & anti-automation on auth/OTP/sensitive endpoints
remediation_plan.detail: Per-IP and per-account limits at the gateway (e.g. Nginx/Cloudflare) plus progressive delays and CAPTCHA after failures.

remediation_plan.title: Account lockout & credential-stuffing detection
remediation_plan.detail: Temporary lockout, breached-password check (HIBP k-anonymity), alert on spikes of failed logins.

remediation_plan.title: Output encoding + Content-Security-Policy
remediation_plan.detail: Framework auto-escaping, strict CSP, sanitize rich text (DOMPurify).

remediation_plan.title: Harden session & token lifecycle
remediation_plan.detail: Short-lived access tokens, refresh token rotation, server-side revocation on logout / password change.

remediation_plan.title: Encrypt all data in transit (TLS 1.2+)
remediation_plan.detail: HTTPS/SFTP/TLS everywhere incl. internal hops carrying sensitive data; HSTS on public sites.

remediation_plan.title: Lock down the cache
remediation_plan.detail: Require AUTH/ACLs, private network only, TTLs for sensitive keys.

remediation_plan.title: Private buckets + short-lived signed URLs
remediation_plan.detail: Block public access, per-object authorization, URL expiry <= 15 min.

remediation_plan.title: Parameterized queries / ORM-only data access
remediation_plan.detail: Ban string-built SQL, add SAST rule (Semgrep) in CI.

remediation_plan.title: Harden file uploads
remediation_plan.detail: Type/size allow-list, re-encode images, malware scan, store outside web root with random names, serve via signed URLs.

remediation_plan.title: Move secrets to a secrets manager & rotate
remediation_plan.detail: Vault / AWS Secrets Manager / Doppler, no keys in git or .env on servers, secret scanning in CI.

remediation_plan.title: Dependency scanning & patching cadence (SCA)
remediation_plan.detail: Dependabot/Renovate + OSV/Trivy in CI, monthly patch window.

remediation_plan.title: OTP/SMS pumping controls
remediation_plan.detail: Per-number and per-country limits, CAPTCHA before sending, alert on SMS spend anomalies.

remediation_plan.title: Remove secrets from mobile/web clients
remediation_plan.detail: Move third-party keys server-side, use short-lived tokens, enable Play Integrity / App Attest.

remediation_plan.title: Schema-based input validation & allow-listed fields
remediation_plan.detail: Validate every request body against a schema (pydantic/Joi/FormRequest); block mass assignment with explicit DTOs.

remediation_plan.title: Authenticate service-to-service traffic
remediation_plan.detail: mTLS or signed service tokens between internal services; network policies.

remediation_plan.title: Role-based access control on every privileged function
remediation_plan.detail: Deny-by-default middleware, role checks on server for admin APIs, tests per role.

remediation_plan.title: Centralized security monitoring & alerting
remediation_plan.detail: Ship auth, admin and payment events to a SIEM/log platform; alert on anomalies; on-call runbook.

remediation_plan.title: Redact sensitive fields from logs
remediation_plan.detail: Mask national IDs, card data, tokens and medical details in application and gateway logs.

remediation_plan.title: Least-privilege database accounts
remediation_plan.detail: Separate read/write accounts per service, no app access with DBA rights, no direct internet exposure.

remediation_plan.title: WAF / CDN with DDoS protection in front of public endpoints
remediation_plan.detail: Cloudflare / AWS WAF managed rules, bot protection, origin locked to CDN.

remediation_plan.title: Generic error responses, no stack traces in production
remediation_plan.detail: Global exception handler, debug mode off, correlation IDs instead of details.

remediation_plan.title: Encrypt sensitive data at rest
remediation_plan.detail: Managed disk/DB encryption plus field-level encryption for national IDs, IBANs, medical notes.

remediation_plan.title: Data minimization & DPA with third parties
remediation_plan.detail: Send only the fields the provider needs; sign a data-processing agreement (Egypt PDPL 151/2020, KSA PDPL).

remediation_plan.title: Tamper-evident audit log for sensitive actions
remediation_plan.detail: Log who/what/when for access to patient/employee/payment records and admin changes; ship to append-only storage.

remediation_plan.title: Use Keystore/Keychain for on-device sensitive data
remediation_plan.detail: No tokens or PHI in SharedPreferences/AsyncStorage; encrypted storage, wipe on logout.
